title: Hematoma Block for Distal Radius Fracture
official: Comparison of Ultrasound-guided Hematoma Block and "Blind" Hematoma Block for Analgesia in Distal Radius Fractures
summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the efficacy of ultrasound guided hematoma block versus traditional "blind" hematoma block for analgesia in distal radius fracture reduction.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patient ≥ 18 years old presenting to the emergency department with complaint of distal radius fracture

Exclusion Criteria:

* High acuity/distress per the Attending ED physician
* Altered mental status or intoxication
* Aphasia, mental retardation, dementia, or insurmountable communication barrier
* Acute psychiatric illness
